This is to inform you that the Department of Management Studies is planning to conduct, t he 
Tally ERP 9.0 / SPSS / MS Office  Certification classes for Third-semester students to enhance 
knowledge in Tally ERP, Statistical package, MS Office  and core specialization areas. Hence all the

30/06/2022.
